title: Transitions through normalized root inclusions
statement: Let ell be prime, W a scheme, M an integral pro-etale sheaf, and P_n integral sheaves. Suppose q:M≅G_m and r_n:mu_(ell^(n+1))≅P_n are isomorphisms, and i_n:P_n→M satisfy r_n followed by i_n followed by q equal to the actual roots inclusion. Then the actual roots tower transition followed by r_n and i_n equals r_(n+1) followed by i_(n+1) followed by ell on M. [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface, def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf]

source.place: Step (3), the actual power-ell roots transitions.

proof.text: The actual power-ell transition followed by the lower inclusion is the upper inclusion followed by multiplication by ell on units. This is the sectionwise power identity for the actual roots tower.

Postcompose the desired equation by q. Substitute the two prescribed inclusion formulas and use the power identity. Multiplication by ell commutes with q in any preadditive category. Cancel the monic isomorphism q. This needs no derived category, Tate line, or scalar normalization.

theorem kummer_kernel_transition (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (M : DiagonalAb W) (P : ℕ → DiagonalAb W)
    (q : M ≅ Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf W)
    (r : ∀ n, Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf W (ℓ ^ (n + 1)) ≅ P n)
    (i : ∀ n, P n ⟶ M)
    (hin : ∀ n, (r n).hom ≫ i n ≫ q.hom =
      Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityInclusion W (ℓ ^ (n + 1))) :
    ∀ n, (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower W ℓ (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime)).map
      (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫ (r n).hom ≫ i n =
      (r (n + 1)).hom ≫ i (n + 1) ≫ (ℓ • 𝟙 M)
